entities.summary: Josephine Ettel Kabli[c]k, also given as Josefina Kablíková, was a Czech pioneering botanist and paleontologist. She studied under the best botanists of her time. She collected plant and fossil samples for institutions throughout Europe. Several fossil animals and plants described from her collections. The plant species Petasites kablikianus and the fossil organism Amphisauropus kablikae are named in her honour.
